a. [ईर्-मक्] 
__1 Agitated. 
__2 Going constantly or instigating everything ([[Sāy.]]) -ind. Here, in or to this place. 
-र्मः The arm; the fore-quarter of an animal; ईर्माभ्यामयनं जातम् [[
a. Ved. Full-haunched, or thin-haunched. N. of a team of horses (of the sun's car); ईर्मान्तासः सिलिकमध्यमासः [[
